claim: Code relocated into 0x3Dxx may stop a native JNext run, with the DivMMC automatic-paging region as a suspected but unproven cause.
limit: Cause not proven; only the move from 3D80 to 3600 is shown to help.

evidence.text: Relocated padding copy at 3D80 passed the simple model but stopped native JNext after 17 updates; moved to 3600 it ran 180 updates matching state at every update. The 3Dxx automatic-paging cause is an inference.
